sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The SheefGG piggy bank is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 16 inventory slots in a 4x4 grid and only takes up 4 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- GP coin
- TarCoin
- Physical Bitcoin
- Right half of a Physical Bitcoin
- Left half of a Physical Bitcoin
